mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build an addition or convert existing space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project duration depends on the scope of work, permitting reviews, structural framing, and interior finishes. Standard interior conversions or garage renovations often move faster because the foundation and exterior envelope already exist. Ground-up home additions and detached suites require longer schedules to accommodate site excavation, concrete foundation curing, structural inspections, exterior stucco application, and drywall finishing. Lead times for customized components, such as bathroom tile, specialized cabinetry, and architectural roof trusses, also affect the schedule, making thorough upfront planning essential to prevent mid-project construction pauses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary by project type: interior conversions take less time since the structure exists, while ground-up additions require more time for foundation, framing, and inspections.
